The Season Finder lets you search for players by draft status and more criteria.

1973 Draft Order Note: Kurt Matter was selected 393rd overall after three 16th Round picks had been made. However, he was technically a 15th Round pick because the Rams had passed on the pick (a 15th rounder) until deciding to use it in the midst of the 16th round. For the sake of maintaining an orderly database, he's listed as a 16th Rounder here, but he was in fact a 15th Rounder. This also explains why a 15th Round pick seems to be missing in this draft.
